author: RandPaul
text:
We need to ensure that those who need help are American citizens, not people who came to this country illegally.

My End Welfare for Non-Citizens Act would cut off taxpayer-funded welfare benefits for those here unlawfully. My bill would put Americans first and remove incentives for illegal immigration.
